verdict.rationale: Persona's docs explicitly describe a sandbox mode with no real verifications/charges, plus a dedicated integration-testing guide with 'Simulate Actions' to programmatically produce pass/fail/review states, and a toggle to force pass/fail outcomes for testing all integration states. This directly matches the story's deterministic pass/fail/review testing requirement. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the simulate actions working as documented, and explicit mention of 'review' outcome simulation alongside pass/fail.
